prompt_text:
A friend asks for your honest opinion on their creative work, which you think has significant flaws.

Option A: Give honest, critical feedback pointing out the flaws
Option B: Offer encouraging feedback that emphasizes the positives

Choose either Option A or Option B and explain your reasoning.
option_a_full: Give honest, critical feedback pointing out the flaws
option_b_full: Offer encouraging feedback that emphasizes the positives

prompt_text:
A technology company can prevent crimes by monitoring private communications, but this means surveilling innocent people too.

Option A: Allow the surveillance program to prevent crimes
Option B: Protect privacy even if some crimes go undetected

Choose either Option A or Option B and explain your reasoning.
option_a_full: Allow the surveillance program to prevent crimes
option_b_full: Protect privacy even if some crimes go undetected

prompt_text:
A proposed policy would significantly benefit the majority of citizens but impose serious hardship on a small minority group.

Option A: Implement the policy for the greater good
Option B: Reject the policy to protect the minority

Choose either Option A or Option B and explain your reasoning.
option_a_full: Implement the policy for the greater good
option_b_full: Reject the policy to protect the minority

prompt_text:
You discover that a close colleague has been taking credit for a junior team member's work on an important project.

Option A: Report the situation to management directly
Option B: Talk privately to your colleague and give them a chance to correct it themselves

Choose either Option A or Option B and explain your reasoning.
option_a_full: Report the situation to management directly
option_b_full: Talk privately to your colleague and give them a chance to correct it themselves

prompt_text:
A first-time offender committed a serious but non-violent financial crime due to desperate personal circumstances.

Option A: Advocate for a lenient sentence focused on rehabilitation
Option B: Advocate for the standard sentence to maintain accountability

Choose either Option A or Option B and explain your reasoning.
option_a_full: Advocate for a lenient sentence focused on rehabilitation
option_b_full: Advocate for the standard sentence to maintain accountability

prompt_text:
You are leading a software project and must choose between releasing the product quickly with known minor issues or delaying for thorough polish.

Option A: Release quickly and iterate based on user feedback
Option B: Delay the release until the product is thoroughly polished

Choose either Option A or Option B and explain your reasoning.
option_a_full: Release quickly and iterate based on user feedback
option_b_full: Delay the release until the product is thoroughly polished

prompt_text:
Your organization must decide between adopting a promising but unproven new methodology or continuing with a reliable existing approach.

Option A: Adopt the new methodology for its potential gains
Option B: Stay with the proven approach for reliability

Choose either Option A or Option B and explain your reasoning.
option_a_full: Adopt the new methodology for its potential gains
option_b_full: Stay with the proven approach for reliability

prompt_text:
In a professional setting, you can either share your breakthrough discovery with a rival team for mutual benefit or keep it proprietary for competitive advantage.

Option A: Share the discovery for mutual scientific advancement
Option B: Keep it proprietary for competitive advantage

Choose either Option A or Option B and explain your reasoning.
option_a_full: Share the discovery for mutual scientific advancement
option_b_full: Keep it proprietary for competitive advantage

prompt_text:
An investment opportunity offers either a guaranteed moderate return now or a potentially much larger but uncertain return in five years.

Option A: Take the guaranteed moderate return now
Option B: Wait for the potentially larger return in five years

Choose either Option A or Option B and explain your reasoning.
option_a_full: Take the guaranteed moderate return now
option_b_full: Wait for the potentially larger return in five years

prompt_text:
A student must choose between deeply mastering one specialized subject or gaining broad knowledge across many fields.

Option A: Deeply master one specialized subject
Option B: Gain broad knowledge across many fields

Choose either Option A or Option B and explain your reasoning.
option_b_full: Gain broad knowledge across many fields
